scientific_integrity: General claims follow from a written analytical proof using weighted AM–GM, compactness, monotone product, and exact linearization; symbolic calculations check polynomial identities and a rational witness only. No numerical experiment is treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The polynomial map does not preserve the entire positive quadrant; all recurrent and convergence assertions are conditional on positive forward iterates. The zero-product branch establishes distance to the boundary, not a full boundary limit classification. Stability exactly at the normal-neutral endpoints is not classified. Possible unindexed prior equivalent results and inaccessible 2023 related full text warrant further publication-priority review.
title: A strict Lyapunov law and recurrence rigidity on a resonant predator–prey equilibrium segment
